name: MareDare 2: The Daring Sequel
storyline: Merry Berry, the berry loving mare is back at it again with another dare! This time, she has been given a brand new dare from her rival, Pokey the spike loving mare. In this new dare, she must traverse all 4 super challenging levels while collecting all the berries in each one all the while dodging hazardous spikes! Will she be able to collect all the berries to finish the dare in MareDare 2: The Daring Sequel, the heart pumping 3D platformer? That falls into your hands, the player!
summary: It's time for another dare with Merry Berry, the berry loving mare! This time, she's been given a dare by the spike loving mare, Pokey! She must collect all the berries while dodging all the spikes in all 4 levels to finish the dare in this heart pumping 3d platformer!
